description: This Java class implements the command strategy for handling 'SudoRetrieveThing' commands in a persistence context. It defines how to determine if the command applies, processes the command to retrieve a 'Thing' with optional selected fields, and constructs the appropriate result, including schema version determination and entity tagging.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles 'SudoRetrieveThing' commands, providing methods for command applicability, execution, and result construction.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Determines if the command applies to the current context and entity, based on existence and deletion status.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve the 'Thing' entity, constructs the JSON representation with optional selected fields, and returns the result.

methods.name: determineSchemaVersion
methods.description: Chooses the appropriate JSON schema version based on command flags and the entity's implemented schema version.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles cases where the command is not applicable by returning an access error.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag, if any.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag from the new entity, if available.
